description: ​Track KPI performance instantly with Thermometer by MAQ Software. Designed to highlight progress against goals in a simple, familiar format, this visual makes it easy to monitor actuals, thresholds, and targets in a single view. Business Uses: Manufacturing - Track inventory levels, throughput, rate of return, maintenance costs, uptime, average delivery time, and average number of shipments Human Resources - Track average attendance, employee turnover, and employee satisfaction Sales and Operations - Visualize progress toward quotas, targets, and service benchmarks Key Features: Customizable fill and border color Define minimum and maximum values for the scale Turn the tick bar on or off for flexible presentation Apply scale formatting options for better labeling and readability Show multiple values on the temperature scale for enhanced target and threshold visualization What's New in 4.3.0.0: New scale formatting options New multiple-value support in the temperature scale New label, axes formatting options Contact Us: Thank you for using Thermometer by MAQ Software. Do you have questions about this or any of our other Power BI custom visuals? Check out our community pages on Zendesk: https://bit.ly/maqpbivizfaq.
